comment: Package carousel media lists — SSOT for read-catalog-view.readMediaItems(). Each entry: identity + media_items array (kind: 'screenshot' | 'generated' | OPEN string). L117: NO fabricated placeholders. A package appears here ONLY once it has REAL media (an actual captured screenshot for UI packages, or real generated art produced by running a generation_descriptor below). Until then the package is absent from this array and readMediaItems falls back to the package's REAL preview_art (a single genuine image) — never a fake gray box. Real media is produced by dispatching the generation_descriptors (image-generation / composition-scene-renderer owners, by address) — a publish/generation step, not authored here.

generation_descriptors.comment: Process descriptors for generating images. Reuse image-generation and renderer owners by ADDRESS. Caller-supplied descriptors (L069 pattern): non-UI packages reference these; composition slots execute them via compute.process.

non_ui_package_screenshot.description: Render a package screenshot for non-UI packages. Dispatches to composition-scene-renderer owner (by address: package::composition-engine::scene-renderer) to render a scene and capture the output.

appropriate_image_generation.description: Generate an 'appropriate' image for a non-UI package. Dispatches to image-generation owner (by address: package::image-generation::generate-image) with the package context.
appropriate_image_generation.source_owner: package::image-generation (image generation owner, generic, caller-supplied descriptor)
